summary.text: J. Stuart Adams is a Republican member of the Utah State Senate for District 7, which covers parts of Davis and Morgan counties, serving since 2010, and holds the office of Senate President. The Legislature's roster lists him as a businessman.

paragraphs.text: Adams earned a B.A. in business finance from the University of Utah, according to the Utah Legislature's roster.
